programContributorCreate.title: Creează profilul tău cu acord explicit

examples.curl:
curl --fail-with-body -X POST https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/program/me/contributors \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: exemplu-programContributorCreate-001' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"Exemplu sintetic","summary":"Exemplu sintetic","categories":[]}'
examples.python:
import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN', 'Idempotency-Key': 'exemplu-programContributorCreate-001', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
payload = json.loads('{"name": "Exemplu sintetic", "summary": "Exemplu sintetic", "categories": []}')
data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
request = urllib.request.Request('https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/program/me/contributors', data=data, headers=headers, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    raise

examples.curl:
curl --fail-with-body -X PUT https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/admin/program/contributors/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: exemplu-programAdminContributorSave-001' \
  -H 'X-CSRF-Token: exemplu' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"Exemplu sintetic","summary":"Exemplu sintetic","categories":[]}'
examples.python:
import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN', 'Idempotency-Key': 'exemplu-programAdminContributorSave-001', 'X-CSRF-Token': 'exemplu', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
payload = json.loads('{"name": "Exemplu sintetic", "summary": "Exemplu sintetic", "categories": []}')
data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
request = urllib.request.Request('https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/admin/program/contributors/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', data=data, headers=headers, method='PUT')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    raise
